C1.statement: The connection pool is implemented in Golang.

C2.statement: The connection type inside the pool is interface{}, making it more general.
C2.fragment: 连接池中连接类型为`interface{}`，使得更加通用

C3.statement: There is a maximum idle time for connections; connections exceeding it are closed and discarded, which can avoid automatic invalidation during idle.
C3.fragment: 连接的最大空闲时间，超时的连接将关闭丢弃，可避免空闲时连接自动失效问题

C4.statement: The pool supports a user-set ping method to check connection connectivity; invalid connections are discarded.
C4.fragment: 支持用户设定 ping 方法，检查连接的连通性，无效的连接将丢弃

C5.statement: Channels are used to handle connections in the pool, described as efficient.
C5.fragment: 使用channel处理池中的连接，高效

C6.statement: The factory field is the method for creating connections, returning net.Dial to tcp 127.0.0.1:4000 in the example.

C7.statement: The close field is the method for closing a connection, calling Close on the net.Conn in the example.
C7.fragment: close := func(v interface{}) error { return v.(net.Conn).Close() }

C8.statement: The ping field is a method for checking connections, as shown commented out.

C9.statement: A connection pool is created with InitialCap 5, MaxIdle 20, and MaxCap 30 in the example.
C9.fragment: 创建一个连接池： 初始化5，最大空闲连接是20，最大并发连接30

C10.statement: The InitialCap configuration field is the initial number of connections in the resource pool.

C11.statement: The MaxIdle configuration field is the maximum number of idle connections.

C12.statement: The MaxCap configuration field is the maximum number of concurrent connections.

C13.statement: The IdleTimeout configuration field is the maximum idle time; connections exceeding this time are closed, which can avoid idle EOF and automatic invalidation.

C14.statement: A pool is created via pool.NewChannelPool using the poolConfig.

C15.statement: An error from pool.NewChannelPool is printed.

C16.statement: A connection is obtained from the pool via p.Get.

C17.statement: A connection is returned to the pool via p.Put.

C18.statement: All connections in the pool are released via p.Release.

C19.statement: The current number of connections is viewed via p.Len.

C20.statement: The pool is implemented with reference to fatih/pool, changing and adding some existing features.
C20.fragment: 该连接池参考 [https://github.com/fatih/pool](https://github.com/fatih/pool) 实现，改变以及增加原有的一些功能。

questions: What happens on Get when no connection is available and MaxCap is reached — does it wait, block, or error? The README does not specify.
Is there a timeout or deadline for Get/Put/waiting? No waiting or timeout behavior is stated beyond IdleTimeout.
What happens when the pool is exhausted or MaxCap is exceeded on Put — is the connection closed, discarded, or blocked? Unspecified.
Does Release close all connections via the Close function, and what happens to connections currently checked out? Unspecified.
Does Put perform a ping check before returning a connection to the pool, and what happens to invalid connections on Put vs Get? Unspecified.
When is IdleTimeout enforced — on Get, on Put, or by a background routine? Not stated.
Is IdleTimeout applied to connections sitting idle in the pool only, or also to checked-out connections? Not stated.
If Ping is nil/not set, does the pool skip connectivity checks? Not stated.
What does Len count — idle connections only, or all connections including checked-out ones? Only '当前连接中的数量' is given, ambiguous.
Is the pool safe for concurrent use? Not stated.
What error does NewChannelPool return and under what conditions? Not stated.
After Get returns an invalid connection detected by ping, is the caller expected to retry, or does the pool return an error? Unspecified.
What is the relation between MaxIdle and MaxCap when returning a connection and the idle count exceeds MaxIdle? Unspecified.
Is there a defined ordering between obtaining from factory, ping checking, and returning to caller on Get? Not specified as a sequence.
